A RESOLUTION DECLARING THE TREUTLEN COUNTY BOARD OF REGISTRARS’ INTENT TO CHANGE THE VOTING PRECINCT BOUNDARIES WITHIN TREUTLEN COUNTY, GEORGIA.

On this day, the 7, day of May, 2017, the Treutlen County Board of Registrars have met for the purpose of discussing and Passing a Resolution, declaring its intent to change the voting precinct boundaries within the boundaries of Treutlen County, Georgia.

WHEREAS, the Treutlen County Board of Registrars is charged with the authority and responsibility to register voters within Treutlen County, Georgia, maintain voter records, and to determine precinct boundaries of the various voting districts for elections; and

WHEREAS, the Treutlen County Board of Registrars believes that it is in the best interests of Treutlen County and its citizens to modify and otherwise change the boundaries of the voting precincts within Treutlen County, Georgia; and

WHEREAS, the Treutlen County Board of Registrars has previously discussed the possibility of consolidating the five voting precincts within Treutlen County, Georgia, into two precincts, being known as the Soperton Precinct and the Annex Precinct, for the purposes of convenience and cost savings; and

WHEREAS, the Treutlen County Board of Registrars has conferred with the Legislative and Congressional Reapportionment Office of the State of Georgia and said Office has recommended changes to the voting precinct boundaries;

THEREFORE, upon a motion and second by the Treutlen County Board of Registrars, such resolution was passed unanimously, and the Treutlen County Board of Registrars declares and issues the following Resolution:

BE IT RESOLVED, that the Board of Registrars of Treutlen County, Georgia, hereby modifies and otherwise changes the boundaries of the voting districts within Treutlen County, Georgia, as follows:

District One (1)

The voters in District One who live south of Turpentine Road (between Harmony Church Road and Georgia Highway 15) will be a part of the Soperton Precinct.

The voters in District One who live north of Turpentine Road (between Harmony Church Road and Georgia Highway 15) will be a part of the Annex Precinct.

The voters in District One who live south of Rocky Creek (between Georgia Highway 15 and Georgia Highway 29) will be a part of the Soperton

Precinct.

The voters in District One who live north of Rocky Creek (between Georgia Highway 15 and Georgia Highway 29) will be a part of the Annex Precinct.

District Two (2)

The voters in District Two who live west of Louisville Road will be a part of the Soperton Precinct.

The voters in District Two who live east of Louisville Road will be part of the Annex Precinct.

District Three (3)

All voters who live in District Three will be a part of the Annex Precinct.

District Four (4)

All voters who live in District Four will be a part of the Annex Precinct.

District Five (5)

All voters who live in District Five will be a part of the Soperton Precinct.

The Board hereby directs its deputy registrars and clerical staff to begin the task of creating the revised voters’ list, as revised, beginning with Districts

One and Two, as they shall contain split voting precinct assignments.

SO RESOLVED, this 24 day of May, 2017.

Election Superintendent

Sworn and subscribed before me this 2274 day of May 2017.
